message.content:
Based on the latest information available, the current stable version of Kubernetes is **1.36.3**, which was released on July 22, 2026.

According to the sources:

- [github.com](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/releases) shows v1.36.3 among the recent releases
- [kubernetes.io](https://kubernetes.io/releases/) indicates "Latest Release: 1.36.2 (released: 2026-06-09)" though this appears to be slightly outdated
- [endoflife.date](https://endoflife.date/kubernetes) confirms version 1.36.3 was released on July 22, 2026
- [versionlog.com](https://versionlog.com/kubernetes/) also confirms 1.36.3 as the "Latest Stable" version, released on July 22, 2026

Additionally, there are development versions in progress:
- Version 1.37 is currently in development with release candidates available (v1.37.0-rc.0 and beta versions)

Kubernetes follows a support model where they maintain the most recent three minor releases (currently 1.36, 1.35, and 1.34), with approximately 1 year of patch support for versions 1.19 and newer.
